name: TC-SR-005 — 买手审核判定规则验证 [P1]
description: 验证判定规则：单组可用≥5张为该组通过，迭代通过组数≥3组为通过，否则为驳回
page: 迭代详情-试拍与评审 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const passGroups = text.match(/(\d+)\s*组?通过/)?.[1]; const totalGroups = text.match(/总(\d+)组|共(\d+)组/)?.[1] || text.match(/(\d+)\/(\d+)/)?.[2]; const verdict = text.includes('判定通过') ? 'pass' : text.includes('判定驳回') ? 'reject' : 'unknown'; return { passGroups, totalGroups, verdict }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const hasStandard = text.includes('单组') && text.includes('5'); const hasIterStandard = text.includes('3') && text.includes('组'); return { hasSingleGroupStandard: hasStandard, hasIterationStandard: hasIterStandard }; })()

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 检查判定标准展示
2. 弃用部分图片后验证结论实时刷新
3. 验证通过/驳回判定逻辑
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 判定标准展示：单组可用≥5张、迭代通过≥3组
2. 当前结论随标注实时刷新
3. 驳回时需填写整体驳回原因
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/试拍与评审
